rationale: Uncovered subsystem: all ten prior runs landed in fs, time/clock, sched priority, epoll_ctl, socket creation and readv; virtual memory has never been touched. brk02 is one localized defect, and the owning code is already visible. brk02 expands brk by two pages, mprotect()s the middle page PROT_READ, expands once more, then shrinks brk back to the original break. The mprotect splits the heap into multiple VmMappings, and Heap::modify_heap_end (kernel/src/process/process_vm/heap.rs:143) calls vmar.resize_mapping(heap_start, old_size, new_size, true) with check_single_mapping=true. check_lies_in_single_mapping (kernel/src/vm/vmar/vmar_impls/mod.rs:211) then requires one VmMapping to cover the whole heap and returns EFAULT once it is split, so modify_heap_end takes its Err path and sys_brk returns the unchanged old break. Both the post-mprotect expand and the shrink-back therefore report the wrong break, which is one root cause explaining the whole failure. Tractable rather than a missing feature: the source comment at heap.rs:138-142 says check_single_mapping=true was chosen 'for simplicity', not for correctness, and mremap.rs:89 already drives the same resize_mapping with check_single_mapping=false, so the multi-mapping path exists and is exercised. Linux brk has no single-VMA requirement. Preferred over the alternatives examined: mincore01-04, splice01/02 and tee01 are absent from the syscall table entirely (kernel/src/syscall/arch/x86.rs) and are missing features, not defects; socketpair01 is already effectively fixed on branch fix-ltp-socket01-STzXZ3, which rewrote syscall/socketpair.rs onto a shared net/socket/create.rs carrying the EOPNOTSUPP/EPROTONOSUPPORT/ESOCKTNOSUPPORT classification it needs; epoll_wait02 is a tst_timer_test timeout-accuracy test and flaky under QEMU; ioctl07 needs both RNDGETENTCNT and a /proc/sys/kernel/random/entropy_avail file, so two features; statfs03 and semget02 both need setuid plus DAC permission enforcement, a wider surface than one syscall.
notes: Pool entry is line 53 of all.txt, '# brk02'; brk02 is in no blocked list, so the all.txt pool applies and the verify configuration is the default with no workdir override, hence run_vars is empty. Host baseline measured this run against pinned LTP 20260529 (/nix/store/hik6kb512ia3p14lc2vwzb292d4k306a-ltp-20260529): 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 broken, both the libc and the raw-syscall variant, so the test is valid on real Linux and the test has 2 variants that must both pass. Not re-probed in Asterinas: select.cache already holds probe=fail for brk02 at commit e8f2b9ca6 from run-iIbwju, which is this run's exact base_commit, so per cache.md it is usable as-is rather than stale. No host or Asterinas run was spent on any other candidate this round, so only the one host record was appended. Adjacent entry worth knowing: brk01 sits on line 52 of all.txt, also commented, and select.cache carries a stale-entry pass for it at e8f2b9ca6 from run-iIbwju, so brk01 is ready work for a later round independent of this one.
